takeaway: Plain backdrop (grey, white, black or a bare room with one chair), controlled light, the outfit is the subject: full length, a turn, close-ups of boning and lacing. 106 ads, 82 of them Bupbes, mostly 5–8 s videos and carousels; Malimarea, Maël and RUE de RUE shoot the same way. takeaway: No person: packshots on white, hanger shots, styled flat-lays with handwritten names, a hand opening the box. Only 9 ads, but 8 are still running: JUBIN STUDIO’s corset flat-lay carousel has run 489 days (the longest ad in the file), Maël’s corset sheet 121 days.

takeaway: A concept shoot: a built set or a dramatic place (river and forest, sea rocks at sunset, crystal chandeliers on black, a horse in a field), styled like a magazine. 28 ads from IAM COCO, Maël and Bupbes; 24 still running. sher_test: One campaign shoot per collection, run against the studio video to see if the extra cost earns longer runs.

takeaway: A photographer in a real place but no story: villa rooms, stone courtyards, terraces, staircases; natural poses, good light. 32 ads, mostly IAM COCO, JC de JC and Cherie; 27 still running. IAM COCO’s café-courtyard “Siren Call” carousel has run 172 days, Cherie’s “A Study in Lace” 165.
sher_test: The middle option SHER can shoot often: one model, one good Bangkok location, 4–6 photos per corset.

takeaway: Looks self-filmed: mirror selfies, try-ons talking to camera in a showroom or bedroom, snapshots at dinner, a café clip. 43 ads, mostly JC de JC and JUBIN STUDIO, 31 of them videos, 40 still running. JUBIN’s 18 s try-on video has run 418 days; RUE de RUE’s customer-photo carousel 245.
sher_test: A KOL try-on of one corset as a 15–20 s phone video, talking to camera, against the studio video on the same budget.
